description: Complete a plan for export by adding what it lacks; run it once `lint` is clean. Two stages. `furnish` puts furniture, by room use, in each rectangular room that holds none (single-storey plans; a furnished room is never touched, and one that lacks a piece its use requires is named in `unresolved` with the missing pieces, not filled; placement is `against wall` / `in <room> anchor`, never absolute). `sheet` adds the sheet statements the plan lacks (`paper`, `scale`, `dims auto`, `title`, `schedule rooms`, `legend`), choosing the finest standard scale on the smallest sheet that holds the drawing. It fills only what is missing and deletes nothing; `only` runs one stage; `reissue:true` may replace `paper`/`scale` (only those) when the drawing does not fit them. Returns { ok, changed, changes, unresolved, source }; a plan that does not compile comes back untouched with `ok:false`, and a room or a sheet that would raise a new diagnostic is left as it was, with the reason in `unresolved`.

only.description: Run only this stage. Default: `furnish`, then `sheet`.

reissue.description: Allow `paper` and `scale` to be replaced when the drawing does not fit the authored sheet.

name: finish
title: Finish the drawing
